findings.finding: The preflight drone inspection panel occupies the lower half of the centre viewport, so the authored ground is only visible as a band above it. This panel is pre-existing UI and is unchanged by this slice; it was confirmed independent of the scene by varying the launch platform albedo across three values with no effect on the panel.
findings.disposition: Out of scope for the map redraw. The same ground is fully visible in scene_shots/04_spawn_forward.png.

findings.finding: The cloud layer is four flattened shaded spheres. They read as distant lens-shaped cloud under fog, but do not stand up to close inspection from above.
findings.disposition: The CloudLayer node and its visible mesh geometry are a headless gate contract, so the layer cannot be removed. Documented for the post-CAP-006 visual pass.

checked: objects readable as a mountaintop flight field: two hardstands, soil aprons, taxiway, hangar, control tower, depot, workshop, fuel tank, two boulders
scale plausible and ground-contacting: no floating or half-sunk landmarks at any station
no white models: every Kenney asset renders with its colormap texture on both Free Flight maps
no missing texture, z-fighting, or clipping observed at any station
sky, fog and exposure consistent from 80 m field level to 420 m altitude
spawn pads and flight corridor legible from the spawn, with the valley open ahead rather than blocked by a landmark
